title: The Vibe Companion: Claude Code in your browser

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Claude code is terminal only, but someone reverse engineered a hidden SDK URL flag in the binary and built a full web UI. No API key needed. It runs on your existing Cloud Code subscription. Now run Cloud Code from your browser with multiple sessions, real-time streaming, approved deny permissions, and nested sub aent visualization. includes live cost tracking, drag drop images, and dark
